youzimu · 柚字幕隐私说明

生效日期：2026 年 11 月 19 日，适用于 0.3.2。

用途与数据处理

柚字幕支持原始音频下载。用户可提供 YouTube 视频、小宇宙单集或 Apple Podcasts 单集链接；插件读取相应标题和可直接下载的完整音频地址，再交给 Chrome 下载，保留来源文件格式，不录音、不转码、不生成语音。

柚字幕在用户明确操作时，获取 YouTube 已有字幕，供本地搜索、复制和导出。会处理所选视频的 URL、ID、标题、作者、字幕语言、时间轴和文本；批量任务还会保存用户提供的链接及其处理状态。不会监测与此用途无关的浏览活动。

存储、保留与删除

成功字幕只保存在当前 Chrome 配置文件的 chrome.storage.local 中，不通过 Chrome 同步上传。缓存有效期 30 天，容量上限约 7 MB 或 100 条，旧记录会在新增缓存时淘汰。过期内容不再使用或显示，实际移除发生在下一次缓存写入或用户清除时。偏好和最近一次批量任务记录保留至用户清除或卸载插件。用户可在「设置与隐私」中清除全部本地数据。导出的文件和已复制的文本由用户自行管理，卸载不会删除下载文件。

网络与第三方

插件直接向 YouTube 发送用户选择的视频请求，必要时使用浏览器已有的 YouTube 会话。插件不读取 Cookie、密码或账号登录令牌。播放器提供的字幕地址可能包含临时签名、会话或访问参数；这些地址只在内存中用于获取你选定的字幕，不写入本地缓存。获取期间可能短暂观察当前视频的字幕请求，并请求播放器重载当前字幕轨道一次，以复用平台自身的字幕响应；不切换 CC 或字幕语言，不改变播放位置，结束后停止观察。YouTube 会接收到普通网络请求中的 IP 地址及其会话信息，其处理受 YouTube/Google 自身政策约束。插件不运行自有服务器，不把视频链接、字幕、历史或使用统计发送给开发者、分析平台、广告商或 AI 服务。

权限

sidePanel 用于侧边栏；storage 用于本地缓存、偏好与任务；scripting 用于用户操作时读取 YouTube 播放器字幕轨道、在页面会话中请求字幕，以及点击时间戳定位视频；alarms 用于串行批量任务的恢复与限流延后重试。必需网站权限仅限 www.youtube.com 和 m.youtube.com。音频功能按需申请 downloads，以及所选来源的 www.xiaoyuzhoufm.com 或 itunes.apple.com 访问权限。小宇宙和 Apple 元数据请求不附带登录凭据；媒体文件由 Chrome 直接向来源 CDN 请求，Chrome 可能附带该域名已有的 Cookie，插件不读取 Cookie。实现只按本插件创建的下载 ID 查询进度，不扫描其他下载；不读取无关网页或磁盘任意文件。

数据使用承诺

数据仅用于上述单一用途，不出售，不用于广告、不做信用评估，不进行人工审阅或与无关第三方共享。没有遥测、追踪器、远程执行代码或付费 API。插件不提供账号注册。

本地排查信息

获取失败时可主动点击「复制排查信息」，把版本、所选视频 ID、语言、请求阶段、HTTP 状态和计数复制到剪贴板。字段经过白名单过滤，不包含字幕正文、完整字幕请求地址、Cookie 或会话令牌，不会自动发送。失败批量任务可能随任务记录保存这些状态计数，清除本地数据或卸载插件可删除；剪贴板或自行分享的副本由用户管理。

音频下载记录

用户主动下载 YouTube 音频时，还可能短暂读取当前页面的媒体资源记录，仅复用媒体 ID 与音轨匹配的原生地址；不持续监测，不执行解签代码。

音频地址仅在解析和发起下载时使用，不写入插件的 local 或 session 存储。文件内容不经过插件缓存。storage.session 最多保留 20 条下载 ID、标题、文件名、平台和开始时间，用于恢复进度；关闭浏览器或清除本地数据会移除这些记录。Chrome 自己的下载历史可能保留原始下载地址、文件名和位置，由浏览器管理。清除插件数据不会删除已下载文件或 Chrome 下载历史，也不会撤销已经授予的权限；可在 Chrome 扩展程序详情中管理权限。

联系与变更

发布后可通过 Chrome Web Store 的开发者联系渠道提出隐私或数据问题。本地版本尚未发布，使用者可直接联系向其提供安装包的开发者。未来如改变数据用途，将更新此说明并按需要取得用户同意。

本工具与 YouTube 或 Google 没有隶属关系。

youzimu privacy policy

Effective November 19, 2026. Applies to version 0.3.2.

Purpose and information handled

youzimu supports original audio downloads from selected YouTube videos, Xiaoyuzhou episodes and Apple Podcasts episodes. It reads the selected source metadata and hands a complete, directly available audio URL to Chrome. It preserves the source format without recording, transcoding or synthesizing speech.

On user request, youzimu retrieves existing YouTube captions for local search, copying and export. It handles the selected video URL and ID, title, author, caption language, text and timestamps. Batch jobs retain the submitted video IDs and processing state. It does not monitor unrelated browsing.

Local storage and deletion

Successful captions use chrome.storage.local in the current Chrome profile, not Chrome sync. Cached captions expire after 30 days, with a limit of approximately 7 MB or 100 entries. Expired captions are not used; physical removal occurs on a later cache write or manual clear. Older entries may be evicted when space is needed. Interface language, text-format preferences and the latest batch job remain until cleared or the extension is uninstalled. Use Clear local data under Settings and privacy to remove these records. Downloaded files and copied text are managed by the user and are not deleted when the extension is uninstalled.

YouTube requests

Requests go directly to YouTube and may use the browser's existing YouTube session. The extension does not read cookies, passwords or account sign-in tokens. Player-provided caption URLs may contain temporary signatures, session or access parameters. They are used in memory to retrieve the selected captions and are not stored in the caption cache.

During a user-initiated request, the extension may briefly observe that video's caption requests and ask the player to reload its current native track once. It does not toggle CC, change caption language or change playback position. Observation stops when the retrieval ends. YouTube receives ordinary request information, such as IP address and applicable session data, under its own policies.

Permissions

sidePanel displays the workspace. storage saves local captions, preferences and tasks. scripting reads player caption metadata, requests existing captions in the page session and seeks the video only when a timestamp is clicked. alarms resumes sequential batches and cooldown retries. Required site access remains limited to www.youtube.com and m.youtube.com. Audio downloads request the optional downloads permission and, only for the selected metadata provider, optional access to www.xiaoyuzhoufm.com or itunes.apple.com. Podcast metadata requests omit credentials. Chrome downloads the media directly from its host/CDN and may attach cookies already set for that hostname; the extension does not read those cookies. The implementation queries only download IDs it created and does not scan unrelated downloads. No recording or microphone permission is requested.

Diagnostics and data use

After an error, users may choose Copy diagnostics. Its allowlisted fields include version, selected video ID, language, request stage, HTTP status and counts. It excludes caption text, full caption URLs, cookies and session tokens. Failed batch records may retain those state counts locally. Diagnostics are not sent automatically; copied or voluntarily shared copies are managed by the user.

youzimu operates no backend and sends no content or usage analytics to the developer, advertisers, analytics providers or AI services. Data is used only for the caption and original audio features, not sold, used for advertising or credit decisions, or manually reviewed by the developer through the extension.

Audio download records

On an explicit YouTube audio download, existing media resource records on the current page may be read transiently. Only a matching media ID and audio format are reused. No persistent monitoring or signature-deciphering code is used.

Resolved audio URLs are used transiently and are not stored in the extension's local or session storage. Audio bytes do not enter the extension cache. Up to 20 download IDs, titles, filenames, platform names and start times are kept in chrome.storage.session for progress restoration, until browser shutdown or a manual clear. Chrome's own download history may retain the original media URL, filename and file location. Clearing extension data does not remove downloaded files or Chrome download history, or revoke granted permissions. Permissions can be managed in Chrome's extension details.

Contact and changes

After publication, privacy questions can be sent through the developer contact channel in the Chrome Web Store. This local version has not been published; contact the developer who provided it. Any future changes to data use will be reflected in this policy and will request consent where needed. youzimu is independent and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
